prompt: A shrine built of stacked human skulls and yellowed ribcages, a bone ossuary reliquary rising from a fetid black swamp. Weathered bone-ivory and moss-green, half-sunk in stagnant black water, tangled cypress roots around its base. The background is a dim, sickly-green swamp at dusk with dead trees. Wide establishing shot of the structure.

An ornate reliquary casket of tarnished gold and bleached bone, a small jeweled ossuary box resting on a cracked stone pedestal. Skull motifs and wine-purple gemstones set into the lid, tarnished brass filigree. The background is the gloom of a swamp crypt, black water seeping across the stone floor. Close artifact view, the casket centered.

A tall bone shrine silhouetted against a sickly green-grey twilight sky, standing alone deep in a black swamp. The ossuary tower of pale skulls reads as a dark silhouette over the glowing fog, reflected in still black water below. The background is a vast misty wetland of dead skeletal trees. Atmospheric wide landscape, the shrine small and distant.

A skull-stacked reliquary shrine in a black swamp, wisps of violet and sickly-green necromantic mana curling up from its hollow eye sockets. Bone-ivory structure slick with moss, the only light source is the eerie purple-green glow leaking from the skulls. The background is dark stagnant bog water and dead reeds. Medium shot of the glowing shrine.

A reliquary tower built from dozens of stacked human skulls, each skull clearly defined with dark hollow eye sockets, mortared together into a grim spire standing in a black swamp. Bone-ivory skulls streaked with green algae, half submerged in stagnant water. The background is a dim murky bog with dead trees. Medium shot, the skull-spire centered and clearly legible as skulls.

An ornate golden reliquary casket adorned with a carved skull and wine-purple gems, resting on a stone altar half-sunk in a black swamp, faint violet necromantic light glowing from the cracks of its lid. Tarnished gold filigree and bone-white carvings, moss creeping over the altar. The background is dark stagnant swamp water and dead cypress. Medium shot, the glowing casket centered.

A grim swamp altar fashioned from a giant horned animal skull and antlers, used as a bone reliquary, draped with rotting cloth and a string of finger-bones, set in black bog water. Bleached bone-ivory against deep emerald moss, violet candle-flames burning in the eye sockets. The background is a foggy black swamp with skeletal trees. Medium shot of the skull-altar.

An ornate golden reliquary casket crowned with a carved skull and inset wine-purple gems, standing on a mossy stone plinth in a black swamp, faint violet necromantic glow seeping from its seams and reflecting in the still bog water below. Tarnished gold filigree, bone-white skull carvings, deep emerald moss. The background is a dim foggy swamp with dead cypress trees. Medium shot, the glowing casket centered above its reflection.

A reliquary shrine nestled in a hollow dead tree-stump in a black swamp, its alcove packed with bleached skulls and tarnished gold offerings, a single wine-purple gem glowing among the bones. Weathered grey bark, bone-ivory skulls, deep emerald moss, black water at the base. The background is a murky bog with skeletal trees and drifting fog. Medium shot of the shrine-hollow.
